whatsappMessage:
Hi Palak Unisex Salon Team,

I noticed your salon has exceptional 4.8★ reviews with over 650 happy clients in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new appointments.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, service menu, aur bridal packages integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/palak

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Palak Unisex Salon Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Palak Unisex Salon With Academy) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, service menu, and your strong 4.8-star reputation in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
